description: This PHP source file defines the class 'UndeployedMetaDataImplementation', which is responsible for managing metadata related to views (such as layouts and forms) for a module in the SuiteCRM system. It implements methods for loading, deploying, and constructing file paths for view metadata, with integration to package modules and relationship handling.

classes.name: UndeployedMetaDataImplementation
classes.description: A class that manages undeployed view metadata for modules, including loading, saving, and path construction for different view types within a package context in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the metadata object for a specific view and module within a package, loading layout definitions, setting up relationships, and handling language strings.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns a string representing the language context tied to the package and module.

methods.name: deploy
methods.description: Saves a provided layout definition to the appropriate file location, updating the history as needed.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Constructs the full path for a specific view metadata file within the package.

methods.name: getFileNameInPackage
methods.description: Constructs the full path for a specific view metadata file, optionally within a specified package.

methods.name: getModuleDir
methods.description: Returns the directory name of the current module.
